correctness.rationale: A parity-character filter of a rotated square gives the two geometric products, including removable singular cases. A numerical independent FFT construction was checked for 50 odd N and 176,850 frequencies; only the analytic derivation proves all N.

value.rationale: A natural nonrectangular, large-density Lee shift kernel in infinitely many odd torus sizes is invertible with exact sharp worst-frequency amplification and exactly four extremal modes.
